description: Replication Data for: Economic topology optimization of District Heating Networks using a pipe penalization approach is a data set deposited in KU Leuven RDR by its authors Yannick Wack (Associatie KU Leuven). A data-set including the structure, input parameters and optimization results of the heating network used in the test case of the paper "Economic topology optimization of District Heating Networks using a pipe penalization approach". The optimization results can be replicated using the methodology and formulations described in the paper. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. Formats: Excel. Size stated: 54426. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
